title: selenicereus hondurensis
intro: Selenicereus hondurensis, commonly known as Honduran night-blooming cereus, is a species of flowering cactus native to Central America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Selenicereus hondurensis include vasodilation and antioxidant activity, which may help to lower blood pressure and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
